conflict.course_category_code_taken: A course category with that code already exists.
conflict.course_code_taken: A course with that code already exists.
conflict.path_code_taken: A learning path with that code already exists.
conflict.path_step_course_taken: That course is already a step in this path.
conflict.path_step_sequence_taken: Another course already occupies that position in this path.

notice.actionsAreUsability: These are the actions the record’s state allows. The API decides who may perform them; this list is not a permission check.
notice.countsAreOfThisPage: Counts marked as such are over the rows on this page. The totals beside each heading are the server’s own.
notice.derivedExpiry: Validity is calculated from the certificate's own date each time this is read.
notice.derivedOverdue: Overdue is calculated from the due date each time this is read.
notice.externalInstructor: An external instructor is recorded here only. No employee record is created for them.
notice.noAggregateScore: Assessment results are recorded as outcomes. This product calculates no overall score, because none was specified.
notice.noCategoryListing: These are the categories used by the courses on this page. This product has no query that lists every category a tenant has.
notice.noDocumentBytes: An evidence document is a reference that was confirmed to exist. No file is stored, served or linked here.
notice.noNotificationDelivery: An intent to notify is recorded. Nothing in this product delivers it, so no message has been sent.
notice.noSupersessionLink: A superseded certificate says so. The certificate that replaced it is not carried by this read.
notice.notScheduled: Recurring requirements are generated when somebody runs them. Nothing in this product runs them on a schedule.
notice.readTeamUnavailable: A manager cannot read their own team here: this product cannot yet tell which employment a signed-in person is.
notice.selfServiceUnavailable: Reading your own record is not available: this product cannot yet tell which employment you are.
notice.sequenceIsNotAPrerequisite: A position is an order, not a gate. Nothing in this product requires one course before another.
notice.unauthenticated: Not signed in. This product has no authentication adapter yet, so every business read is refused until one is supplied.
notice.versionsAreImmutable: A published version is never edited. A completion describes the version somebody actually sat.

rejection.assessment-date-invalid: The assessment date must be a calendar date.
rejection.assessment-enrolment-closed: This enrolment has already ended, so no further result can be recorded against it.
rejection.assessment-mark-invalid: A mark must be a number the tenant recorded, not free text.
rejection.assessment-mark-scale-required: A mark needs the scale it was measured against.
rejection.assessment-not-human: An assessment result must be recorded by a named person.
rejection.assessment-title-required: An assessment needs a title in both languages.
rejection.assessment-version-mismatch: That assessment belongs to a different version of the course.
rejection.assignment-course-not-published: That course has not been published, so it cannot be assigned.
rejection.assignment-due-date-invalid: The due date must be a calendar date.
rejection.assignment-employment-unknown: That employment could not be confirmed.
rejection.assignment-occurrence-key-invalid: The occurrence must be a calendar date.
rejection.assignment-path-required: An assignment from a learning path must name the path.
rejection.assignment-rule-required: An assignment from a mandatory rule must name the rule.
rejection.assignment-satisfaction-requires-evidenc: Closing a requirement needs the enrolment or certification that satisfied it.
rejection.assignment-transition-refused: That assignment cannot move to that state.
rejection.assignment-waiver-not-human: A waiver must be granted by a named person.
rejection.assignment-waiver-reason-required: A waiver needs a written reason.
rejection.certification-completion-requires-enrolm: A certification from a course completion must name the enrolment.
rejection.certification-employment-unknown: That employment could not be confirmed.
rejection.certification-enrolment-not-completed: That enrolment has not been completed.
rejection.certification-enrolment-other-employment: That enrolment belongs to a different employment.
rejection.certification-enrolment-unknown: That enrolment could not be found.
rejection.certification-evidence-unknown: That evidence document could not be confirmed.
rejection.certification-issue-date-invalid: The issue date must be a calendar date.
rejection.certification-not-human: A certification must be issued by a named person.
rejection.certification-revocation-reason-required: Revoking a certification needs a written reason.
rejection.certification-transition-refused: That certification cannot move to that state.
rejection.certification-validity-before-issue: A certificate cannot expire before it was issued.
rejection.certification-validity-date-invalid: The validity date must be a calendar date.
rejection.certification-validity-invalid: The validity period must be a whole number of months.
rejection.completion-date-invalid: The completion date must be a calendar date.
rejection.completion-not-human: A completion must be recorded by a named person.
rejection.completion-requires-assessment: This course requires a passed assessment before it can be completed.
rejection.course-category-unknown: That course category could not be found.
rejection.course-code-invalid: A course code may use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
rejection.course-description-incomplete: A description must be given in both languages.
rejection.course-duration-invalid: The duration must be a whole number of minutes.
rejection.course-name-required: A course needs a name in both languages.
rejection.course-transition-refused: That course cannot move to that state.
rejection.course-version-number-invalid: A version number must be a positive whole number.
rejection.course-version-title-required: A course version needs a title in both languages.
rejection.employment-unavailable: The employment records could not be reached, so nothing was reconciled.
rejection.enrolment-course-not-enrollable: That course cannot be enrolled into.
rejection.enrolment-employment-unknown: That employment could not be confirmed.
rejection.enrolment-transition-refused: That enrolment cannot move to that state.
rejection.instructor-employment-unknown: That employment could not be confirmed.
rejection.instructor-identity-ambiguous: An instructor is either an employee or external, never both.
rejection.instructor-identity-required: An instructor needs either an employment or an external name.
rejection.instructor-internal-has-no-external-deta: Contact details for an employee belong to their employment record.
rejection.instructor-name-required: An external instructor needs a name in both languages.
rejection.path-already-archived: That learning path has already been archived.
rejection.path-archived: That learning path has been archived.
rejection.path-code-invalid: A path code may use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
rejection.path-description-incomplete: A description must be given in both languages.
rejection.path-name-required: A learning path needs a name in both languages.
rejection.path-requires-steps: A learning path needs at least one course before it can be published.
rejection.path-step-sequence-invalid: A step position must be a positive whole number.
rejection.reconcile-rule-retired: That requirement has been retired, so it implies nothing new.
rejection.rule-already-retired: That requirement has already been retired.
rejection.rule-course-not-published: A requirement must point at a published course.
rejection.rule-due-window-invalid: The completion window must be a whole number of days.
rejection.rule-effective-date-invalid: The effective date must be a calendar date.
rejection.rule-name-required: A requirement needs a name in both languages.
rejection.rule-organization-unit-required: A requirement for an organization unit must name the unit.
rejection.rule-organization-unit-unknown: That organization unit could not be confirmed.
rejection.rule-position-required: A requirement for a position must name the position.
rejection.rule-recurrence-invalid: The repeat interval must be a whole number of months.

withheld.assignmentClosed: This requirement is closed. Satisfied, waived and cancelled are all endings.
withheld.certificationSuperseded: This certificate was replaced by a later one.
withheld.courseArchived: An archived course is final. It is kept so earlier certificates stay explainable.
withheld.enrolmentCompleted: A completion is a record of what happened and is not edited. A certificate is issued from it.
withheld.enrolmentEnded: This enrolment ended without a completion.
withheld.pathEmpty: A path with no courses cannot be published: anybody would satisfy it by doing nothing.
withheld.ruleRetired: A retired requirement generates nothing new. What it already asked of people is unchanged.
